title: Brand guidelines
text:
Author: **Priya Raman** · Final as of October 2026
## App icon
Two overlapping speech bubbles forming a "P". It won the team vote (Maya and Sam voted for it) and tested best with the Westbrook students.
- Use the teal icon on light backgrounds and the white icon on dark backgrounds
- Never stretch, rotate, or add shadows to the icon
## Colors
- **Deep teal** `#0F766E` - primary buttons, icon, headers
- **Warm coral** `#F97362` - highlights, reminders, the "Join group" button
- **Off-white** `#FAF7F2` - backgrounds
- **Charcoal** `#1F2937` - body text
## Fonts
- Headings: Poppins SemiBold
- Body text: Inter Regular
## Voice
Friendly and short, like a classmate, not a teacher. Example: "Your group meets in 30 minutes. Bring your notes!"
